name: Lightning-TS-TW
blurb: Lightning bolts fork and branch across the canvas.
description: Procedurally generated lightning effects using WebGL. Configurable branching, color, and animation speed.
use_when: Dramatic storm or energy effects on backgrounds.
avoid_when: Devices without GPU acceleration; power-sensitive mobile devices.
a11y: Decorative background. No keyboard or focus handling required.
